## Setup

```{python}
from ocha_stratus import list_container_blobs, open_blob_cog
import ee
import geemap
import rioxarray  # registers .rio accessor
import tempfile
import os
from pathlib import Path
```

## Authenticate GEE

```{python}
# Run once interactively, then comment out
# ee.Authenticate()

ee.Initialize(project="YOUR_GEE_PROJECT_ID")
```

## List SEAS5 blobs

```{python}
blobs = list_container_blobs(
    name_starts_with="seas5/monthly/processed/",
    stage="prod",
    container_name="raster",
)
print(f"{len(blobs)} blobs found")
blobs[:5]
```

## Inspect a single COG

```{python}
sample = open_blob_cog(
    blob_name=blobs[0],
    stage="prod",
    container_name="raster",
)
print(sample)
print(sample.rio.crs)
print(sample.dims)
```

## Create GEE ImageCollection

```{python}
GEE_ASSET_COLLECTION = "projects/YOUR_GEE_PROJECT_ID/assets/seas5_monthly"

try:
    ee.data.createAsset({"type": "ImageCollection"}, opt_path=GEE_ASSET_COLLECTION)
    print(f"Created: {GEE_ASSET_COLLECTION}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Already exists (or error): {e}")
```

## Ingest COGs as assets

GEE ingestion requires local files — each COG is loaded from blob, written to a
temp GeoTIFF, then submitted as an ingestion task. Tasks run async server-side.

```{python}
def blob_to_asset_id(blob_name: str, collection: str) -> str:
    return f"{collection}/{Path(blob_name).stem}"


def ingest_cog(blob_name: str, collection: str) -> None:
    asset_id = blob_to_asset_id(blob_name, collection)

    try:
        ee.data.getAsset(asset_id)
        print(f"skip (exists): {asset_id}")
        return
    except Exception:
        pass

    da = open_blob_cog(blob_name=blob_name, stage="prod", container_name="raster")

    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".tif", delete=False) as tmp:
        tmp_path = tmp.name

    try:
        da.rio.to_raster(tmp_path, driver="GTiff")
        task_id = ee.data.uploadToEarthEngine(
            open(tmp_path, "rb"),
            {"name": asset_id},
        )
        print(f"started: {asset_id} (task: {task_id})")
    finally:
        os.unlink(tmp_path)


for blob in blobs:
    print(blob)
    ingest_cog(blob, GEE_ASSET_COLLECTION)
```

## Check task status

```{python}
for t in ee.data.getTaskList()[:10]:
    print(t["state"], t.get("description", ""))
```

## Preview collection (once ingested)

```{python}
col = ee.ImageCollection(GEE_ASSET_COLLECTION)
print("Image count:", col.size().getInfo())

m = geemap.Map()
m.add_layer(col.first(), {}, "SEAS5 first image")
m
```
